description: Extract dominant colours from an image using k-means++ clustering. Accepts a public image URL or base64-encoded image. Returns hex values with proportional weights sorted by luminance. Optionally runs palette_analyse on the results. Returns hex values with proportions, the input palette_analyse and palette_swatch take. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.

analyse.description: If true, also run palette_analyse on the extracted colours and return archive names

archive.description: Explicit single archive name to restrict matching to e.g. 'MarsColour', 'Japan', 'Victorian'.

grey_card_hex.description: Hex value sampled from a grey or white card in the image for white balance correction e.g. #C8C8C8

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image data (small images only, under 50 KB)

image_id.description: Ephemeral image_id from ingest_image (preferred for images over 50 KB)

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to extract colours from

k.description: Number of colours to extract (3-12, default 6)

style_context.description: Plain English style description that restricts archive matching to a coherent set e.g. 'English cottage garden', 'Victorian', 'Japanese', 'MarsColour', 'Arts and Crafts'. Prevents palette colours from being named across unrelated archives.

name: palette_extract
title: Extract Dominant Palette Colours
